headline: Disney Plus tries a new AI-powered search
summary: Disney+ is testing an AI tool for personalized show and movie recommendations. Users can employ natural language, voice queries, or suggested prompts. This system aims to go beyond basic viewing history recommendations.

headline: Microsoft Edge is about to lock out older ad blockers, just like Chrome did
summary: Microsoft Edge will end support for Manifest V2, blocking popular ad blockers like uBlock Origin. This move mirrors Google Chrome's earlier decision. Only a few MV2 extensions with 'meaningful usage' remain on Edge.

headline: How police left a registered sex offender free to murder and attack women
summary: A senior Met officer admitted Sheryl Wilkins' murder could have been prevented. Simon Levy, a registered sex offender, was allowed to remain free. This led to him murdering Wilkins and attacking other women.

headline: Serial sex offender guilty of murdering two women and raping third
summary: Simon Levy, a serial sex offender, has been found guilty. He was convicted of murdering two women and raping a third. Levy was reportedly under monitoring by the Metropolitan Police.

headline: Cambridge to review process for hiring senior academics after Jason Arday resignation
summary: Cambridge University will review its process for hiring senior academics. This decision follows the resignation of Professor Jason Arday. A review group member argues Cambridge shouldn't 'mark its own homework'.

headline: US appeals court halts Trump ballroom project paving way for Supreme Court showdown
summary: A US appeals court has blocked a Trump ballroom project. The court stated Congress should decide on such a 'massive ballroom'. This decision sets the stage for a potential Supreme Court review.
